# ArtCraft application icons — license and provenance

The icons in `public/icons/` for PhotoCraft, VectorCraft, FilmCraft, LightCraft, PdfCraft,
EffectCraft, AniCraft, DesignCraft, FigCraft, TextureCraft, MaterialCraft,
WordCraft, SoundCraft, DeckCraft, CADCraft, GridCraft and Craft Anything are
copied **unmodified** from the ArtCraft Team's official launcher:

https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher/tree/main/assets/app-icons

The launcher README describes individual Craft app icons as licensed like the
respective applications (MIT OR Apache-2.0). For these copies we use the MIT option.
